messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPENED · SEV2 · us-east-1 third-party dependency degradation impacting Hosted API + Dedicated pools. Start 2026-03-09T02:01:08Z. Pager notified.
marc-oncall: ack — I'm on it. seeing elevated 5xx and latency from multiple routes. paging SRE.
sophia-sre: quick triage: spike in 5xx (502/504) starting ~02:00 UTC. Errors correlate with our AWS STS token exchange calls and CloudWatch Logs PutLogEvents timeouts for us-east-1. Logs show repeated "504 Gateway Timeout" and "RequestTimeout" from upstream.
kevin-support: customer impact: 8% error rate for Hosted API in us-east-1 over last 7m; ~10 Dedicated customer pools in that region report increased request failures. Flagging for comms.
marc-oncall: status: enabling routing fallback for new requests to other regions where possible. will also temporarily reduce non-critical logging to avoid observability backpressure.
sophia-sre: posted minimal logs: ```ERROR auth: sts token exchange failed status=500 body="InternalServiceError" host=sts.amazonaws.com``` also: ```WARN obs: PutLogEvents timeout, err="context deadline exceeded"```
mike-sre: I'm joining. plan: 1) Flip smart-routing rule for latency-sensitive routes -> us-west-2 (partial failover). 2) Apply aggressive retries with jitter for STS calls. 3) Turn down log sampling to 20% for non-customer-facing flows. Doing step 1 now.
olga-eng: implementing sampling change in ingestion pipeline: reducing PutLogEvents frequency + disabling verbose model-debug logs in hosted path.
carla-pm: what's the customer comms plan? severity looks high for some customers.
kevin-support: drafting customer note now. Will send targeted messages to affected Dedicated accounts + publish status page update for Hosted API. Template: summary, impact, mitigation, ETA unknown, workaround to route from other regions.
marc-oncall: AWS support case opened (case 987654321) referencing STS/CloudWatch latencies in us-east-1. AWS health shows elevated API errors — awaiting response. linking: https://console.aws.amazon.com/health/home?region=us-east-1 (internal)
sophia-sre: after routing flip we see error rate drop from 8% -> 2.3% in next 3m for routed traffic. Hosted region-wide rate still elevated for sticky sessions. Continuing to drain affected pools.
mike-sre: taking over on-call now — handing off from marc. marc: thanks, please monitor customer escalations. mike-sre: I will coordinate with eng to disable non-essential obs ingestion completely if we see backpressure return.
marc-oncall: handing off full context to mike-sre. log links and runbook attached in thread. :thumbsup:
mike-sre: paging AWS P1 on case, adding logs & pcap. Also throttling outbound STS connections from control plane to reduce retries storm.
kevin-support: sending initial customer notifications (small subset affected) — using template v2. Will update when AWS gives ETA.
incident-bot: ON-CALL HANDOFF logged. New owner: mike-sre. Incident channel pinned to #incidents.
sophia-sre: note — Dedicated pools with pinned capacity in us-east-1 remain partially impacted until we confirm STS stability. fallback routing doesn't affect pinned capacity; advising product to reach out if SLA breaches expected.
mike-sre: current mitigation status: routing fallback active, log sampling reduced, retries tuned, AWS case open. Observed errors reduced to ~1.1% region-wide, latency trending down. Keeping incident open until AWS confirms resolved.
carla-pm: thanks. maintain business impact tracker and list any customers with potential SLA hits.
kevin-support: will follow up with affected customers and keep the support channel updated.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE · SEV2 · mitigation in progress. Next update in 15 minutes or on significant change.
__notes: thread-style Slack export: messages are a continuous string with per-message prefixes. All timestamps are in metadata only.
